# wheelos_core

> Bazel-first Cyber RT middleware for C++17 autonomous systems.

## Canonical documentation

- [Repository README](README.md): build, test, packaging, and integration overview.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): operational docs and reference entry points.
- [Installation and setup](docs/getting-started/installation.md): Bazel dependencies, build steps, and runtime bundle setup.
- [Quick start](docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): minimal publish/subscribe example.
- [Deployment options](docs/guides/build-and-run.md): choose between source-build and packaged runtime workflows.
- [Component development](docs/guides/component-development.md): DAG, launch, and component lifecycle.
- [Generated API index](docs/doxy-docs/source/index.md): generated implementation and API reference.
- [C++ API guide](docs/doxy-docs/source/cpp-api.md): nodes, pub/sub, services, parameters, timers, and records.
- [Python API](docs/doxy-docs/source/python-api.md): Python bindings and examples.
- [Terms](docs/doxy-docs/source/terms.md): framework terminology.
- [Generated C++ API](docs/doxy-docs/source/api/cppapi_index.rst): Doxygen reference.
- [Generated Python API](docs/doxy-docs/source/api/pythonapi_index.rst): Doxygen reference.
- [C++ component example](examples/common_component_example/README.md): build and
  run a shared-library component.
- [Python package example](packaging/pycyber/README.md): build and run a Bazel
  `pycyber` application.

## Build entry points

```bash
bash scripts/build.sh
bazel build //cyber
bazel test //cyber/message/...
bash scripts/release/build_release_artifacts.sh
```

## Documentation build

Read the Docs uses `.readthedocs.yaml` and builds the Sphinx project in
`docs/doxy-docs/source`. The project combines Markdown guides with generated
Doxygen API pages.
